note: CB-S2 / S3 / S4 / S6 (parsers/code/swift/src/lib.rs), measured on HEAD 2170ff8. S2: tree-sitter-swift parses `1 + tax(3)` as call_expression(additive_expression(1, tax), call_suffix) and classify_call reads the additive_expression as a whole-callee ComplexReceiver, so the call is lost. S3: visit_type's body loop reads only function_declaration / class_declaration, so init / deinit / subscript / computed-property bodies mint no METHOD and their calls vanish. S4: no field type is recorded, so `self.repo.load()` has no receiver type. S6: collect_import keeps the text `@testable import App` as the import path, so the test module's IMPORTS cell reads ["@testable import App","XCTest"]. Member calls here use explicit `self.` (SelfMethod) so this fixture does not depend on CB-S1's implicit self.
